marketing_description: The DeWALT DW0822CG Cross Line and Plumb Spot Laser features a self-leveling design and projects two green lines with three beams, providing a working range of 100 ft without a detector and 165 ft with a detector. This laser has an accuracy of +/-3.2 mm at 9.1 m and includes features such as an integrated magnetic pivoting base and IP54 water/debris resistance. It is powered by 2 Ah batteries and comes with a 3 Year Limited Warranty.
